title: Towards Responsible Natural Language Annotation for the Varieties of Arabic

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing hate speech annotation labels from a single cohort of Moroccan annotators against country-specific native dialect experts across 10 Arab nations, using Signal Detection Theory to calculate implied thresholds of annotation strictness and leniency based on dialect.

Measuring in-group versus out-group annotation leniency by evaluating how Moroccan annotators rate social media content from their own country compared to content originating from 9 other Arab nations.
